The board-oriented diagram labels the digital and analog inputs, CAN, RS485, Qwiic and onboard peripherals. Confirm terminal polarity against the board silkscreen. Manufacturer store listing published 2026-11-17 (store publication date).

The external connector drawing shows the keyboard expansion port, 3 x 8 and Qwiic connections. A second drawing lists internal peripheral signals and optional LoRa connections. Manufacturer store listing published 2026-11-16 (store publication date).

The combined 1W1 and 1W2 diagram identifies the 1W2 LR2021 radio, GPS and TF-card GPIO assignments. The expansion header has no pin-by-pin callouts. Manufacturer store listing published 2026-11-23 (store publication date).

The manufacturer identifies the 4.7-inch Basic device and maps the display bus, TF card, I2C devices and buttons. External connector coverage is partial. Manufacturer store listing published 2026-10-16 (store publication date).

The rear-view board drawing maps the 16-position H4 terminal to power, I2C, CAN, RS485 and GPIO48 through GPIO53. The manufacturer also lists H4 and J3 pin numbers. GPIO48 through GPIO53 use native 3.3 V logic. The S3 version has different connections. Exact hardware launch date unknown. Manufacturer documentation names factory firmware dated 2026-10-30.
The printable diagram maps the HUB75 header, bottom-edge expansion pads, Qw/ST connector, debug pins, buttons and RGB LED. Exact hardware launch date unverified.

Physical order of the 40-pin GPIO expansion interface only. The companion pin table identifies the GPIO numbers and input-only pins. Exact launch date unknown. Manufacturer has published the controller and its GPIO expansion diagram.
